How long we keep it

  • Login attempts that are never verified: 24 hours.
  • Sessions: end after 30 days, or 7 days without activity; the IP address and user agent are erased 30 days after the session ends, and the session record is deleted after 90 days.
  • Audit log entries: 1 year.
  • Server logs: about 30 days.
  • Account data, posts and comments: until you delete your account. Posts and comments are then kept without your name.
